description: This file defines utility functions and types for caching, timeout handling, and reading response text, specifically for web-related operations in a TypeScript project.

classes.name: CacheEntry
classes.description: Generic type representing a cache entry with a value, expiration time, and insertion timestamp.

methods.name: resolveTimeoutSeconds
methods.description: Resolves a timeout value, ensuring it is at least 1 second.

methods.name: resolveCacheTtlMs
methods.description: Converts a cache TTL value from minutes to milliseconds, with a fallback.

methods.name: normalizeCacheKey
methods.description: Normalizes cache keys by trimming and converting to lowercase.

methods.name: readCache
methods.description: Reads a cache entry if valid; deletes if expired.

methods.name: writeCache
methods.description: Writes a cache entry, removing oldest if cache exceeds max entries.

methods.name: withTimeout
methods.description: Creates an AbortSignal that aborts after a specified timeout, optionally linked to an existing signal.

methods.name: readResponseText
methods.description: Reads response text with optional max byte limit, handling streaming bodies.
